# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.0 Far Seas & Overseas Exarchates (Slot 42, oe_far_, mode=plan_a_script_div). Generated by gen_far_seas.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# Initialize Far Seas global state (idempotent).
oe_far_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_far_init } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_init value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_n value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_fac_n value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_n value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_last_strain value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_last_div value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_div_yr value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_cnt value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 0 }
    }
}

# Update O(1) top-bar alert cache variable (oe_alert_cache_far_ready) for Route 2 alert #5.
oe_far_update_alert_cache = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_alert_ready_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_far_ready value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_far_ready value = 0 }
    }
}

# Open a factoria at location:$loc$ (mode=1 diplomatic, mode=2 pressure).
# Human-AI parity: if the foreign port owner is a human player, NEVER force-build; send oe_far.14 instead!
oe_far_open_post_at = {
    location:$loc$ = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { is_ai = no } }
            if = { limit = { this = location:suez } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 1 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:jeddah } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:massawa } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:adan } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:hadibu } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 5 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:hormuz } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 6 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:masqat } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 7 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:khambat } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 8 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:goa } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 9 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:kozhikode } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 10 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:kotte } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 11 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:malacca } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 12 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:ceuta } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 13 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:tangier } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 14 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:gibraltar } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 15 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:cadiz } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 16 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:funchal } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 17 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:ponta_delgada } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 18 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:aguere } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 19 } }
            else_if = { limit = { this = location:santiago } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 20 } }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_active value = 1 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_post_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_m value = 12 } }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } }
                    construct_building = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner = root
                        instant = yes
                        cost_multiplier = 0
                        cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { $mode$ = 2 }
                    owner = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_port_pressure target = root } }
                }
                else = {
                    owner = {
                        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_port_charter target = root }
                        add_truce_with = { target = root years = 15 mutual = yes }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_active value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# Build domestic Exarchate seat in best owned East hub (or capital fallback).
oe_far_build_exarch_seat_east = {
    if = {
        limit = { owns = location:kotte }
        location:kotte = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { owns = location:suez }
        location:suez = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        capital = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
}

# Build domestic Exarchate seat in West Exarchate capital (Plan A) or best owned West hub (or capital fallback).
oe_far_build_exarch_seat_west = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_west_co_alive = yes }
        global_var:oe_far_west_co = {
            save_scope_as = oe_far_w_seat_owner
            capital = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } }
                    construct_building = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat
                        owner = scope:oe_far_w_seat_owner
                        instant = yes
                        cost_multiplier = 0
                        cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { owns = location:funchal }
        location:funchal = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { owns = location:gibraltar }
        location:gibraltar = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        capital = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_seat_mark value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat } } construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_exarch_seat owner = root instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        }
    }
}

oe_far_reclaim_east_from = {
        location:suez = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    NOT = { owner ?= root }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                }
                every_buildings_in_location = {
                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:jeddah = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$

                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:hormuz = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    NOT = { owner ?= root }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                }
                every_buildings_in_location = {
                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:masqat = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$
                }

            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    NOT = { owner ?= root }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                }
                every_buildings_in_location = {
                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:khambat = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    NOT = { owner ?= root }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                }
                every_buildings_in_location = {
                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:goa = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_buildings_in_location = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                    owner ?= $target$
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    NOT = { owner ?= root }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root }
                }
                every_buildings_in_location = {
                    limit = {
                        building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria
                        owner ?= $target$
                    }
                    change_building_owner = root
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
            }
            remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = $target$ }
        }
    }
    location:kozhikode = {
        if = {

        }

}

oe_far_create_east_exarchate = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 2 }
        oe_far_sync_east_factorias = yes
    }
    else = {
        save_scope_as = oe_far_overlord
    # Pass 1: prefer an existing eastern foreign factoria (Taprobane/Malabar first).
        if = { limit = { location:kotte = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:kotte = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:kozhikode = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:kozhikode = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:goa = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:goa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:khambat = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:khambat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:malacca = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:malacca = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:adan = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:adan = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hormuz = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:hormuz = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:masqat = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:masqat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hadibu = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:hadibu = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:jeddah = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:jeddah = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:massawa = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:massawa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:suez = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } } location:suez = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
    # Pass 2: else any active eastern corridor port.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_far_hq_site } }
        if = { limit = { location:kotte = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:kotte = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:kozhikode = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:kozhikode = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:goa = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:goa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:khambat = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:khambat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:malacca = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:malacca = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:adan = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:adan = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hormuz = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:hormuz = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:masqat = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:masqat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hadibu = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:hadibu = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:jeddah = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:jeddah = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:massawa = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:massawa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:suez = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } location:suez = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
    }
    # Pass 3: else open a starter foreign factoria at the highest-priority AI eastern port.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_far_hq_site } }
        if = { limit = { location:kotte = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = kotte mode = 1 } location:kotte = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:kozhikode = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = kozhikode mode = 1 } location:kozhikode = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:goa = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = goa mode = 1 } location:goa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:khambat = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = khambat mode = 1 } location:khambat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:malacca = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = malacca mode = 1 } location:malacca = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:adan = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = adan mode = 1 } location:adan = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hormuz = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = hormuz mode = 1 } location:hormuz = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:masqat = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = masqat mode = 1 } location:masqat = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:hadibu = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = hadibu mode = 1 } location:hadibu = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:jeddah = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = jeddah mode = 1 } location:jeddah = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:massawa = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = massawa mode = 1 } location:massawa = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
        else_if = { limit = { location:suez = { has_owner = yes NOT = { oe_far_port_held_by_roman = yes } owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = root } } } } oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = suez mode = 1 } location:suez = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site } }
    }
    # Pass 4: absolute fallback to host capital.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_far_hq_site } }
        capital = { save_scope_as = oe_far_hq_site }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_far_hq_site }
            scope:oe_far_hq_site = {
                create_building_country_in_location = {
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    culture = culture:greek_culture
                    subject_type = subject_type:oe_far_exarchate_trade
                    overlord = scope:oe_far_overlord
                    hidden_effect = {
                        change_government_type = government_type:republic
                        change_heir_selection = heir_selection:bank_selection
                    }
                    save_scope_as = oe_far_east_new
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_far_east_new }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_co value = scope:oe_far_east_new }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 2 }
                scope:oe_far_east_new = {
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = root.culture } } change_culture = root.culture }
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = root.religion } } change_religion = root.religion }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
                                NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade }
                            }
                        }
                        make_subject_of = { target = root type = subject_type:oe_far_exarchate_trade }
                    }
                    set_capital = scope:oe_far_hq_site
                    change_country_name = OE_FAR_TAPROBANE_NAME
                    change_country_adjective = OE_FAR_TAPROBANE_ADJ
                }
                oe_far_sync_east_factorias = yes
            }
            else = {
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

oe_far_create_west_exarchate = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_west_co_alive = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation } }
        random_subject = {
            limit = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation }
            save_scope_as = oe_far_west_new
            change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_far_exarchate
            change_country_name = OE_FAR_HESPERIA_NAME
            change_country_adjective = OE_FAR_HESPERIA_ADJ
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_far_west_new }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_co value = scope:oe_far_west_new }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 2 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america is_capital = no } }
        save_scope_as = oe_far_west_overlord
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { continent = continent:america is_capital = no }
            order_by = population
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_far_west_cap
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_far_west_cap }
            scope:oe_far_west_cap = {
                create_country_from_location = {
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    culture = culture:greek_culture
                    subject_type = subject_type:oe_far_exarchate
                    overlord = scope:oe_far_west_overlord
                    hidden_effect = {
                        change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                    }
                    save_scope_as = oe_far_west_new
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_far_west_new }
                scope:oe_far_west_new = {
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = root.culture } } change_culture = root.culture }
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = root.religion } } change_religion = root.religion }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
                                NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate }
                            }
                        }
                        make_subject_of = { target = root type = subject_type:oe_far_exarchate }
                    }
                    change_country_name = OE_FAR_HESPERIA_NAME
                    change_country_adjective = OE_FAR_HESPERIA_ADJ
                }
                every_owned_location = {
                    limit = {
                        province = scope:oe_far_west_cap.province
                        is_capital = no
                    }
                    change_location_owner = scope:oe_far_west_new
                }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_co value = scope:oe_far_west_new }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 1 }
    }
}

oe_far_sync_plan_a_subjects = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_exarch global_var:oe_far_east_exarch = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes } }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co } remove_global_variable = oe_far_east_co }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            oe_far_sync_east_factorias = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_exarch global_var:oe_far_west_exarch = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_far_west_co_alive = yes } }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_co } remove_global_variable = oe_far_west_co }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_far_west_exarch
            global_var:oe_far_west_exarch = 1
            any_subject = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation }
        }
        oe_far_create_west_exarchate = yes
    }
}

# Annual script-paid commercial dividend (plan_a_script_div; strictly once per calendar year via oe_far_div_yr).
# Never drains a low-treasury/bankrupt building subject; tops up float if < 30g and only sweeps tiny surplus >= 150g.
oe_far_pay_annual_div = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { global_var:oe_far_div_yr ?= current_year }
            oe_far_east_co_alive = yes
            has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n
            global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 1
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_div_yr value = current_year }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_last_div value = oe_far_script_div_val }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_far_last_div > 0 }
            add_gold = oe_far_script_div_val
        }
        global_var:oe_far_east_co = {
            if = {
                limit = { gold < 30 }
                add_gold = 15
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { gold >= 150 }
                add_gold = -25
            }
        }
    }
}

# Reclaim all Plan A factorias and safely annex every Commercial / Overseas Exarchate subject (zero zombie subjects).
oe_far_cleanup_plan_a_subjects = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
            country_exists = global_var:oe_far_east_co
        }
        global_var:oe_far_east_co = { save_scope_as = oe_far_e_recall }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:oe_far_e_recall = {
                    is_subject_of = root
                    is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade
                }
            }
            oe_far_reclaim_east_from = { target = scope:oe_far_e_recall }
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_far_e_recall reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co } remove_global_variable = oe_far_east_co }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade }
        save_scope_as = oe_far_stray_e
        root = {
            oe_far_reclaim_east_from = { target = scope:oe_far_stray_e }
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_far_stray_e reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_far_west_co
            country_exists = global_var:oe_far_west_co
        }
        global_var:oe_far_west_co = { save_scope_as = oe_far_w_recall }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:oe_far_w_recall = {
                    is_subject_of = root
                    is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate
                }
            }
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_far_w_recall reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_co } remove_global_variable = oe_far_west_co }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate }
        save_scope_as = oe_far_stray_w
        root = {
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_far_stray_w reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        }
    }
}

oe_far_recall_exarchs_plan_a = {
    oe_far_cleanup_plan_a_subjects = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_exarch value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_exarch value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_last_div value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_exarch_recalled value = 1 }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto subtract = 30 }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_taprobane_charter } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_taprobane_charter }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_hesperia_exarch } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_hesperia_exarch }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_recall_turmoil years = 10 mode = replace }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain } oe_ar_add_strain = { amount = 6 } }
    oe_far_january = yes
}

# Apply diplomatic opinion modifier to Catholic Iberian powers (Treaty of Tordesillas bridge, zero vanilla var reads).
oe_far_apply_iberian_bias = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { religion = religion:catholic } } c:CAS = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POR c:POR = { religion = religion:catholic } } c:POR = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { religion = religion:catholic } } c:SPA = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ARA c:ARA = { religion = religion:catholic } } c:ARA = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } } }
}

# Sync mutually exclusive 3-tier Spice & West Shipping ledgers + high-autonomy withholding penalty.
oe_far_sync_ledgers = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_1 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_2 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_3 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_east_tier_3 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 5 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_east_tier_3 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 2 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_east_tier_2 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_east_tier_1 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }

    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_1 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_2 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_3 } remove_country_modifier = oe_far_west_tier_3 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n global_var:oe_far_west_n >= 4 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_west_tier_3 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n global_var:oe_far_west_n >= 2 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_west_tier_2 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n global_var:oe_far_west_n >= 1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_west_tier_1 years = 2 mode = replace }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_auto global_var:oe_far_auto >= 70 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_auto_withhold years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_far_auto_withhold }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_far_auto_withhold
    }
}

# O(1) January tally across fixed 12 East + 8 West ports, anti-snowball strain, autonomy drift & Roman Company hook.
oe_far_january = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_n value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_fac_n value = 0 }
    location:suez = {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_n add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active }
                change_variable = { name = oe_far_post_m add = 12 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_fac_n add = 1 }
        }
    }
    location:jeddah = {
        if = {

            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_n add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active }
                change_variable = { name = oe_far_post_m add = 12 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_fac_n add = 1 }
        }
    }
    location:massawa = {

    location:ponta_delgada = {

            }
        }
    }
    location:aguere = {
        if = {

            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_n add = 1 }
            if = {

    location:santiago = {

            change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_n add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active }
                change_variable = { name = oe_far_post_m add = 12 }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_far_has_america_foothold = yes }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_n add = 2 }
    }

    oe_far_sync_plan_a_subjects = yes

    # Autonomy drift while any overseas presence exists.
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 1 }
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n global_var:oe_far_west_n >= 1 }
            }
        }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto add = oe_far_auto_drift }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto min = 0 max = 100 }
    }

    # Anti-snowball strain injection into oe_ar_strain (strictly guarded by has_variable = oe_ar_strain).
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_last_strain value = oe_far_annual_strain }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain global_var:oe_far_last_strain > 0 }
        oe_ar_add_strain = { amount = oe_far_annual_strain }
    }

    # Guarded Roman Company synergy (gen_company.py): East factorias feed oe_cmp_fund and oe_cmp_auto.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
            has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n
            global_var:oe_far_east_n >= 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = oe_far_cmp_east_div }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_auto }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto add = 2 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }

    oe_far_sync_ledgers = yes
    oe_far_update_alert_cache = yes
}

oe_far_envoy_pick_east = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:suez = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = suez mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:jeddah = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = jeddah mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:massawa = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = massawa mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:adan = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = adan mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:hadibu = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = hadibu mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:hormuz = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = hormuz mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:masqat = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = masqat mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:khambat = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = khambat mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:goa = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = goa mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kozhikode = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = kozhikode mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kotte = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = kotte mode = $mode$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:malacca = { oe_far_port_envoy_eligible = yes } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = malacca mode = $mode$ }
    }
}

oe_far_send_enclave_offer_east = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:suez = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 1 }
        location:suez = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:jeddah = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 2 }
        location:jeddah = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:massawa = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 3 }
        location:massawa = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:adan = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 4 }
        location:adan = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:hadibu = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 5 }
        location:hadibu = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }
                owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.14 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:hormuz = { oe_far_port_lease_eligible = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_idx value = 6 }
        location:hormuz = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_owner = yes }

        }

    else_if = {

oe_far_do_lease_accept = {
    location:$loc$ = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes owner = root }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
                change_location_owner = c:ROM
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_port_lease_hub years = 25 mode = replace }
                c:ROM = {
                    add_gold = oe_far_pay_3y
                    add_truce_with = { target = root years = 15 mutual = yes }
                    add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_enclave_lease target = root }
                }
                root = {
                    add_gold = { value = c:ROM.oe_far_cost_3y }
                    add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_enclave_lease target = c:ROM }
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
                change_location_owner = c:BYZ
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_far_port_lease_hub years = 25 mode = replace }
                c:BYZ = {
                    add_gold = oe_far_pay_3y
                    add_truce_with = { target = root years = 15 mutual = yes }
                    add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_enclave_lease target = root }
                }
                root = {
                    add_gold = { value = c:BYZ.oe_far_cost_3y }
                    add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_enclave_lease target = c:BYZ }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_far_do_lease_renew = {
    location:$loc$ = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_active value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_post_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_m value = 12 } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = c:ROM }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } }
                construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria owner = c:ROM instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
            }
            c:ROM = { add_gold = oe_far_pay_halfm }
            root = { add_gold = { value = c:ROM.oe_far_cost_halfm } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = c:BYZ }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_far_factoria } }
                construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_far_factoria owner = c:BYZ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
            }
            c:BYZ = { add_gold = oe_far_pay_halfm }
            root = { add_gold = { value = c:BYZ.oe_far_cost_halfm } }
        }
    }
}

oe_far_do_lease_refuse = {
    location:$loc$ = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_far_lease_cd months = 180 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_far_port_cd months = 180 }
    }
}

oe_far_resolve_lease_accept = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 1 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = suez } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 2 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = jeddah } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 3 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = massawa } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 4 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = adan } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 5 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = hadibu } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 6 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = hormuz } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 7 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = masqat } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 8 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = khambat } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 9 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = goa } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 10 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = kozhikode } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 11 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = kotte } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 12 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = malacca } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 13 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = ceuta } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 14 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = tangier } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 15 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = gibraltar } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 16 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = cadiz } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 17 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = funchal } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 18 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = ponta_delgada } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 19 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = aguere } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_lease_idx global_var:oe_far_lease_idx = 20 } oe_far_do_lease_accept = { loc = santiago } }
}

oe_far_retrench_one_post = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:santiago = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:santiago = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:aguere = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:aguere = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:ponta_delgada = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:ponta_delgada = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:funchal = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:funchal = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:cadiz = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:cadiz = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:gibraltar = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:gibraltar = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tangier = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:tangier = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:ceuta = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:ceuta = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:malacca = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:malacca = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
                    root = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes }
                    NOT = { global_var:oe_far_east_co = { capital ?= { this = location:malacca } } }
                    has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                    is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
                }
                remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kotte = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:kotte = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
                    root = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes }
                    NOT = { global_var:oe_far_east_co = { capital ?= { this = location:kotte } } }
                    has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                    is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
                }
                remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kozhikode = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:kozhikode = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
                    root = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes }
                    NOT = { global_var:oe_far_east_co = { capital ?= { this = location:kozhikode } } }
                    has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                    is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
                }
                remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:goa = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } }
        location:goa = {
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_active
            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
                    root = { oe_far_east_co_alive = yes }
                    NOT = { global_var:oe_far_east_co = { capital ?= { this = location:goa } } }
                    has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
                    is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
                }
                remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = global_var:oe_far_east_co }
            }

    else_if = {

        location:khambat = {

            remove_variable = oe_far_post_m

            if = {

# Fire core Roman event $ev$ respecting Slot 42 main-line lock.
oe_far_fire_core = {
    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 42 }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_cnt add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_m value = oe_far_m_now }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.$ev$
}

# Monthly scheduler tick (Slot 42 in gen_mainline_lock.py + fallback pulse oe_far_pulse.txt).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_far_ran_m; runs in Roman host scope (ROM or BYZ).
oe_far_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { global_var:oe_far_ran_m ?= oe_far_m_now }
            oe_far_roman_host = yes
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ran_m value = oe_far_m_now }
        oe_far_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 }
            oe_far_january = yes
            oe_far_pay_annual_div = yes
        }
        oe_far_update_alert_cache = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_ml_free = yes
                NOT = { global_var:oe_far_ev_m ?= oe_far_m_now }
                current_year <= 1750
            }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_1 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_1 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_2 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_2 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 2 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_3 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_3 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 3 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_4 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_4 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 4 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_5 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_5 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_6 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_6 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 6 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_7 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_7 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 7 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_8 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_8 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 8 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_9 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_9 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 9 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_10 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_10 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 10 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_11 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_11 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 11 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_12 = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_12 value = 1 }
                oe_far_fire_core = { ev = 12 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_far_can_ev_13 = yes }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 42 }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_ev_m value = oe_far_m_now }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.13
            }
        }
    }
}

    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_on value = 1 }

    oe_far_january = yes

    set_variable = { name = oe_far_ev13_cd months = 120 }

    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YEM }
        c:YEM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_far_b_privateer_raid target = root } }
    }

        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_active } remove_variable = oe_far_post_active }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_post_m } remove_variable = oe_far_post_m }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_port_cd } remove_variable = oe_far_port_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_lease_cd } remove_variable = oe_far_lease_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_far_seat_mark } remove_variable = oe_far_seat_mark }
        if = { limit = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted } remove_list_variable = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root } }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_far_port_lease_hub } remove_location_modifier = oe_far_port_lease_hub }
    }
    location:funchal = {

oe_far_test_east = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_t_east value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_canal_stage value = 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_holder value = 1 } }
    oe_far_update_alert_cache = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.1
}

oe_far_test_west = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_t_west value = 1 }
    oe_far_update_alert_cache = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.7
}

oe_far_test_jan = {
    oe_far_january = yes
    oe_far_pay_annual_div = yes
}

oe_far_test_site = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_on value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { location:adan = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = adan mode = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { location:kozhikode = { oe_far_port_has_post = yes } } }
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = kozhikode mode = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_far_open_post_at = { loc = malacca mode = 1 }
    }
    oe_far_january = yes
}

oe_far_test_auto = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto add = 25 }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_far_auto min = 0 max = 100 }
    oe_far_sync_ledgers = yes
}

oe_far_test_ev_3 = {
    oe_far_init = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_on value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_on } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_on value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_on } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_on value = 1 } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.3
}
